name: Evenbreak Career Hive
description: Online career-information hub created by Evenbreak for disabled people, with articles and resources about careers, applications, workplace inclusion and navigating employment.
intended_use: Browse disability-focused career information alongside statutory and employment-rights routes.
audience_or_context: Disabled and neurodivergent jobseekers and workers looking for career information; content is online and not limited to one diagnosis.
limitations: Career guidance cannot guarantee that an employer, vacancy or strategy will be accessible or suitable.
Evenbreak also operates disability-employment services and employer relationships, so its material is not an independent audit of employers.
cost_or_access_notes: The Career Hive is publicly accessible online; separate Evenbreak services can have their own account or employer arrangements.
conflicts_of_interest: Evenbreak is a disability-employment social enterprise/service provider and has commercial relationships with employers; ND Oracle records this conflict context.

provenance.method: Current first-party identity, access route and stated function checked on 2026-08-28. Listing records what the resource is and how to reach it without adopting provider claims of benefit.
